Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware backend was run. The package wraps the registered CartPole environment; the other entry symbols in the card (Quadrotor, BenchmarkEnv, BaseAviary) were confirmed in the clone but are not served by this one-environment GymnasiumDriver. The upstream package was not installed or imported: the fake is the package's pure Python cart-pole (force input, Euler integration, 20 ms timestep) and was never compared with the upstream PyBullet environment; the registered simulator path through gymnasium.make was not run. The fake draws initial states with Python's random.Random while upstream uses numpy's generator, and it returns the modern five-tuple while upstream returns the legacy four-tuple, so one seed gives different trajectories on the two; the fidelity gaps say so. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the pending seed) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived inputs (ticks, action.values and seed on reset and seed). Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
